# links.md — every github link of the corpus, in one file

> this file gathers every github link extracted from the official corpus: the institutional docs of the devthink app, the official rascunho parts and the neodocs digests. it exists so the link knowledge survives even if the source documents are deleted one day. links ride deduplicated, grouped by repository in alphabetical order, with the pinned revisions of the owner archive first. the infra.md keeps only the short reference list at its last paragraph.
